messages:
Sam: RFC: moving routing header from `X-Route` to `x-rd-route`, plus a new policy value `narrowcast`. Plan: soft roll for 30 days where servers accept both. Need SDK+console impact notes.

Nina: Do we have a clear compatibility promise? if servers accept both, when do sdks stop sending old header?

Sam: Servers accept both for 30d. SDKS should default to sending v2 once available but support fallback. No forced break until after notices.

Ravi: For TS/py, I can add a helper enum and a compatibility layer. Suggest exposing a migration helper util instead of strict breaking enum to avoid churn.

Carmen: Go client has strict header validation in the transport. That'll break unless we change it to log+fallback. Can we add an opt-in strict mode for customers who want early enforcement?

Sam: Yes: default permissive; opt-in strict via env var `RD_ROUTE_STRICT=true`. Also console will tag telemetry with `route_policy.v2` to make it filterable.

Nina: Console changes: addition of a small rollout toggle per-tenant and a dashboard tile to show legacy vs v2 split. Also quota attribution will shift for narrowcast workloads 99need billing heads up.

Ravi: Implementation notes: TS 2.x will include `RoutePolicy` helper and `getRouteHeader()` that prefers `x-rd-route`. Python wrapper will add the same helper and a WARN log when legacy header used.

Carmen: Opened Go draft: relax validation, prefer v2 if both present, add test for precedence. Will add opt-in strict flag.

Ops Bot: Deploy scheduled Wed 02:00 UTC. Canary 10% then 50% after 15m if no errors.

Sam: Important: when both headers present, prefer v2. We should document that explicitly. Also add telemetry fields: `route_policy.source` (sdk|manual|gateway), `route_policy.version` (v1|v2), `route_policy.migration_stage` (canary|gradual|ga).

Nina: Good idea on telemetry. That will let us build the tile and run queries for quota changes. Also add a trace tag so we can link request samples to dashboard tiles.

Ravi: Release notes draft: py 1.4.3 - add migration helper + fallback; ts 2.0.2 - helper + opt-in strict; go 0.9.8 - relax header validation, prefer v2 when both present. Emphasize no forced breaks during 30d.

Carmen: Found a small bug in current canary: transport still rejects unknown policy strings; I'll relax validation to WARN instead of error. Tests updated.

Ops Bot: Canary started 9910% traffic to canary cluster. Monitoring: no alerts T+10m.

Sam: Docs: short migration snippet, example headers, and recommended test plan (include billing reconciliation).

Nina: QA: add e2e that posts both headers and asserts v2 wins. Also verify console attribution and quota dashboards for a sample tenant.

Ravi: I'll open PRs today for TS/py. Carmen, please update Go PR once your validation change is in.

Carmen: Will push patch in the morning. Also filing #1278 for the precedence bug.

Sam: Timeline: docs + SDK PRs today, canary tomorrow, GA after 30d if no major issues. I'll send comms to partners and billing. :shipit:
